import pandas as pd
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import seaborn as sns
from io import StringIO

# Create the dataset
data = """brand,model_year,megapixels,max_iso,weight_grams,price_usd,sensor_type,has_video_4k,lens_mount,body_type
Leica,2005,13.5,25600,324,811.8,Micro 4/3,1,E,Compact
Fuji,2019,46.4,51200,1151,3596.41,APS-C,0,EF,Mirrorless
Pentax,2012,38.7,12800,598,3357.2,Full Frame,0,MFT,Mirrorless
Olympus,2015,22.5,6400,1095,1555.7,APS-C,0,Z,Mirrorless
Leica,2016,12.2,25600,290,3899.09,Medium Format,0,MFT,DSLR"""

df = pd.read_csv(StringIO(data))

# Set up the figure with multiple subplots
fig, axes = plt.subplots(2, 3, figsize=(15, 10))
fig.suptitle('Camera Dataset Analysis', fontsize=16, fontweight='bold')

# Color palette
colors = sns.color_palette("husl", n_colors=len(df['brand'].unique()))
brand_colors = dict(zip(df['brand'].unique(), colors))

# 1. Price by Brand (Bar chart)
ax1 = axes[0, 0]
brand_prices = df.groupby('brand')['price_usd'].mean().sort_values(ascending=True)
bars = ax1.barh(brand_prices.index, brand_prices.values, color=[brand_colors[b] for b in brand_prices.index])
ax1.set_xlabel('Price (USD)')
ax1.set_title('Average Price by Brand')
for i, v in enumerate(brand_prices.values):
    ax1.text(v + 50, i, f'${v:.0f}', va='center', fontsize=9)

# 2. Megapixels vs Price (Scatter)
ax2 = axes[0, 1]
for brand in df['brand'].unique():
    brand_data = df[df['brand'] == brand]
    ax2.scatter(brand_data['megapixels'], brand_data['price_usd'], 
                c=[brand_colors[brand]], label=brand, s=100, edgecolors='black', alpha=0.8)
ax2.set_xlabel('Megapixels')
ax2.set_ylabel('Price (USD)')
ax2.set_title('Megapixels vs Price')
ax2.legend(loc='upper left', fontsize=8)

# 3. Sensor Type Distribution (Pie chart)
ax3 = axes[0, 2]
sensor_counts = df['sensor_type'].value_counts()
ax3.pie(sensor_counts.values, labels=sensor_counts.index, autopct='%1.1f%%', 
        colors=sns.color_palette("Set2", len(sensor_counts)), startangle=90)
ax3.set_title('Sensor Type Distribution')

# 4. Weight vs Max ISO (Scatter with body type)
ax4 = axes[1, 0]
body_types = df['body_type'].unique()
markers = ['o', 's', '^']
for i, body in enumerate(body_types):
    body_data = df[df['body_type'] == body]
    ax4.scatter(body_data['weight_grams'], body_data['max_iso'], 
                marker=markers[i % len(markers)], label=body, s=100, edgecolors='black', alpha=0.8)
ax4.set_xlabel('Weight (grams)')
ax4.set_ylabel('Max ISO')
ax4.set_title('Weight vs Max ISO by Body Type')
ax4.legend(fontsize=8)

# 5. Model Year Timeline
ax5 = axes[1, 1]
df_sorted = df.sort_values('model_year')
ax5.scatter(df_sorted['model_year'], df_sorted['price_usd'], 
            c=[brand_colors[b] for b in df_sorted['brand']], s=df_sorted['megapixels']*5, 
            edgecolors='black', alpha=0.8)
for i, row in df_sorted.iterrows():
    ax5.annotate(row['brand'], (row['model_year'], row['price_usd']), 
                 textcoords="offset points", xytext=(0,10), ha='center', fontsize=8)
ax5.set_xlabel('Model Year')
ax5.set_ylabel('Price (USD)')
ax5.set_title('Price by Model Year (size = megapixels)')

# 6. Body Type Count
ax6 = axes[1, 2]
body_counts = df['body_type'].value_counts()
bars = ax6.bar(body_counts.index, body_counts.values, color=sns.color_palette("Set3", len(body_counts)))
ax6.set_xlabel('Body Type')
ax6.set_ylabel('Count')
ax6.set_title('Camera Body Type Distribution')
for i, v in enumerate(body_counts.values):
    ax6.text(i, v + 0.05, str(v), ha='center', fontsize=10, fontweight='bold')

plt.tight_layout()
plt.savefig('output.png', dpi=150, bbox_inches='tight', facecolor='white')
plt.close()
